C: Constant fixed by the free edge
D: Flexural rigidity of the plate, Eh³/12(1 − ν²)
E: Young's modulus of the plate material
I_n: Modified Bessel function of the first kind, order n
J_n: Bessel function of the first kind, order n
T: Tension of the drumhead, per unit length
ell: Side of the square plate or radius of the circular plate
f_01: Frequency of the drumhead's lowest mode (0, 1)
j_nm: The mth zero of the Bessel function J_n
lambda: Frequency parameter of a circular plate mode
m: Number of nodal circles of a drumhead mode, the rim included
m_d: Moving mass of the wave driver
sigma: Mass of the drumhead per unit area
